lines: Minions: a sworn Oath's lines that name only an element (Oath of the Pyre Heart, Frozen Heart, Storm Heart) now count for your minions too, as tree and item lines already did (checked against in-game Skeletal Mage tooltips).
Skill tree search: every matching node and Oath seat now gets a red ring, matching names turn red when zoomed in, and the number of matches shows under the search box.
Minions: the young-gem bonus of a summon gem (Summon Skeletons: up to 30% more below gem level 16) now counts for its minions too.
Summon Skeletons: they attack a little slower, as the game shows (fitted to the game log; Multistrike does not change it). Builds with Skeletons read lower, fast armies the most.
Killer Instinct now counts on minion skills: +4% base crit chance, 100% increased crit chance and +40% crit multiplier for the linked minions.
Minions holding a staff now use the staff's local crit line on their base crit, as the game does (checked against an in-game Summon Skeletons tooltip).

Riven lines: the game counts most offensive Riven lines at 77 to 89% of their roll, and the page now does the same. Riven + gem level lines count in full (Patch 84). A two-handed weapon's +3 gem levels line reads +2, as the game's own table has it.

Guardian life up to Rupture Level 39 now follows the game's own figures on Patch 84 (about twice the old numbers; Gates are much weaker than the Guardians around them). It only changes shock size and Kindling.
Pyre of Faith and Unholy Void: their pulses no longer set off on-hit bursts from the tree and items (Patch 83). Orbiting Hammers on a Necromancer: cast speed past the cap now becomes damage.

"Takes more damage" effects: Woes and Sentences now multiply with each other instead of adding, as the game's own log for Patch 84 lists them as separate kinds. Death Sentence 25% with a 20% Woe is now x1.50 (was x1.45).
Guardians at Rupture Level 22 to 30 have the lower life Patch 84 gave them, read from the game log.
Riven lines are scaled the way the game reads them; from Patch 84 Riven skill level lines count in full.
Necromancer Orbiting Hammers: cast speed past its fastest cast now turns into damage, as for attacks (game log).
Pyre of Faith and Unholy Void pulses no longer set off on-hit effects from your tree and items (Patch 83).

Spells cast through another skill's Cast on Crit link (Venom Spark from Death Coil, for example) now get that skill's fitting supports on the triggered cast, as the game's tooltip says. The panel number stays the hand-cast one the game shows.
Sparks: Convergence is no longer in the panel DPS, because the game's tooltip leaves it out. The numbers against an enemy still count it.
Necromancer: the three Grave Lore points by the start now each add their minion (a Skeleton, a Skeletal Mage or a Zombie), as in Patch 84. The page left them out before.

Patch 84: "takes more damage" effects now follow the new rule. The same kind adds (Woes, Sentences and Unravel; Marks and the War Banner; Maim, the venom golem and hallowed ground) and different kinds multiply. Which kind each effect belongs to is our reading of the patch notes.

Patch 84 numbers: Death Coil, Drain Life, Venom Spark, Skeletons, Skeletal Mages and Zombies use the new high gem level values. An Oathword's power lines count twice on a two-handed weapon again (Nightshade on a staff: +3 levels).

Minions, checked against in-game tooltips: Venom Support converts their damage too, Herald of Rot and the Dragonling's extra poison reach them, your poison-only damage lines count in a new place, Maim is in their DPS, and their crit chance comes from your staff.
Idols: the game counts idol lines at a share of what the Fossil panel shows (generic damage and crit lines half, build lines 30% more). The page now does the same.

Link rule fixes: movement skills lose damage for empty sockets too (Vampire Dash with 2 of 6 deals 43%), and a spell cast through another skill's Cast on Crit counts that skill's fitting supports as links. Movement skill cooldowns stop at 0.3 s.

A Dwarven rune's + gem level line no longer adds a level to skills, Heralds or Vows (the game's tooltips leave it out). Cast speed past a spell's cooldown floor or a channel's fastest tick now becomes damage.
Item editors: new "% of base" box beside Base Grade. Type the % the game shows on the item (Base Grade: 98 Truesworn, 124% of the base) and the page sets the grade; 119% or more ticks Truesworn.
Minions: Glass Cannon now gives every minion 25% more damage (the sim counted nothing from it; checked on the skill panels).
Minions: the venom golem's 7.5% more damage taken now counts for minion hits and poison on real monsters (checked in game logs; the Training Post does not show it).
Minions: Choir of Bones' 12% more damage for projectile minions (Skeletal Mage) and Boundless Mind's 15% less minion damage now count.
Sparks and Winter Orb: cast speed now speeds up their strikes the way the game does (Sparks about 8 to 20% more damage, Winter Orb icicles about 25 to 75% more).
Save Creator: copying a build now copies its sworn Oaths too.
Passive tree: a note and a pulsing diamond show Oath seats you have opened but not sworn an Oath at.
New Support via Ko-fi button (card or PayPal) beside Buy me a coffee.
The whole site is faster: damage numbers calculate about twice as fast, the passive tree and Item Simulator no longer recalculate when nothing changed, and pages load quicker.
Build Planner: clicks and edits respond about twice as fast. Each change no longer re-checks every skill in the list.
Saved Builds now lists only builds you saved yourself. Builds opened from a share link or a code go to their own list below, "Opened, not saved", with a Save button to move one up.
Save as new build under a name you already used saves over that build, so a character you load again updates the same build.
Rune sockets open a searchable list: hover a rune or jewel to see what it gives in a weapon and in armour.
